This small plot of 0.10 hectares is just a corner of my land where I grow something other than my main cereals. Since it is small and close to home, I will put manure from my animals on it rather than buy chemical fertilizer — money is tight and I save the fertilizer for my bigger cereal plots. I will use seed I saved from last season, and my daughters and I will tend it ourselves; no need to hire anyone for such a small piece.
